description.zh:
ACK集群ID。取值来源：
- [DescribeAckClusters](~~DescribeAckClusters~~)：批量查询ACK集群列表。
description.en:
The ACK cluster ID. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAckClusters](~~DescribeAckClusters~~): Lists ACK clusters.

description.zh: ACK集群连接器名称。长度为1~64个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the ACK cluster connector. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: ACK集群资源所属的阿里云UID。
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the account to which the ACK cluster resource belongs.

description.zh:
ACK集群连接器主交换机。取值来源：
- [DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~)：批量查询同步节点交换机列表。
description.en:
The primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Lists the vSwitches of synchronization nodes.
The IP address of the primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector.

description.zh:
ACK集群连接器地域ID。取值来源：
- [DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~)：查询同步节点地域列表。

> 关于云防火墙支持ACK集群连接器地域的详细信息，请参见[ACK集群同步节点](~~2865120~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~): Lists the regions of synchronization nodes.

> For more information about the regions supported by ACK cluster connectors in Cloud Firewall, see [ACK cluster synchronization nodes](~~2865120~~).

description.zh:
ACK集群连接器备交换机。取值来源：
- [DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~)：批量查询同步节点交换机列表。
description.en:
The standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Lists the vSwitches of synchronization nodes.
The IP address of the standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector.

description.zh: ACK集群连接器同步周期间隔。范围：2~60秒。
description.en: The synchronization interval of the ACK cluster connector. Valid values: 2 to 60. Unit: seconds.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## Rate limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If the number of calls exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered, which may affect your business. Manage your calls properly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw create-ack-cluster-connector --member-uid 1358090477150000 --region-no cn-hangzhou --connector-name ack-cluster-connector-name --cluster-id cb0f5640b1b2d404cad6ba21509d7847b --primary-vswitch-id vsw-2zerfbbje7dvnbii20000 --primary-vswitch-ip 10.100.1.1 --standby-vswitch-id vsw-2ze2gtlfozrab01cfo0000 --standby-vswitch-ip 10.100.2.1 --ttl 30 --region cn-hangzhou
